zh: 图像由左侧块状区域和右侧高大的笔画共同组成。
左上块状区域围出一个大的浅色矩形开口。
其下部圆钝区域内有两个较小的浅色开口。
一条高而倾斜的笔画沿图像右侧向上延伸。
一条长下部笔画先向左，再转向较低的末端。
来源元数据预期有四张图，但当前只有一张本地复核图。
en: The image combines a left block with a tall right-hand stroke.
The upper left block encloses a large pale rectangular opening.
Its lower rounded area contains two smaller pale openings.
A tall slanted stroke rises along the right side of the image.
A long lower stroke runs leftward before turning to a lower terminal.
Source metadata expects four images, but only one local review image exists.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
